description: Use when a paid endpoint supports a reusable x402 session or entitlement. Makes one capped payment, stores a non-custodial signed session token, and returns a session_id for x402_session_fetch. Do not use for providers without session semantics, unknown networks, missing spend caps, or calls where the buyer cannot store and audit the returned mcp-session-id/session_id.

body.description: Request body for POST/PUT/PATCH session-start requests

endpoint.description: Base URL to establish a paid session for. For Streamable HTTP MCP gateways, initialize before tools/list or tools/call.

headers.description: Additional request headers for the initial paid request. Do not put private keys here.

label.description: Optional label for this session (e.g., "Premium API session")

max_payment_eth.description: Maximum ETH-equivalent payment cap for opening the session. The call fails closed before signing if the required payment exceeds this cap.

method.description: HTTP method for the initial request (default: GET)

scope.description: "prefix": covers all paths under this URL (default). "exact": single URL only.

ttl_seconds.description: Session TTL in seconds (default: 3600 / 1 hour). Max: 30 days.

name: x402_session_start
